A promising future ahead

Discover how our passionate faculty coupled with small class sizes can inspire you to achieve your undergraduate degree. Experience the value of a Doane education and how it can empower you. 

Your possibilities are endless

Discovering your life’s passion is easier with options. Immersed in the liberal arts, choose from undergraduate and graduate programs — all delivering real-world experience.

Find your program

Let's start your success story, together.

Ready to become a Doane Tiger? Use this easy-to-follow checklist to apply for an undergraduate degree.
  1. Submit your application 
  2. File and submit your FAFSA 
  3. Review and accept your financial aid award 
  4. Make your deposit 
  5. Complete all paperwork (including housing and health forms) 
  6. Student athletes: complete NAIA eligibility requirement at PlayNAIA.org
  7. Sign up for an enrollment day 
  8. Attend new student orientation 
  9. Send in your final transcripts

Transferring? We'd love to have you!

  • Meet our counselors

5 reasons to attend Doane

Students from all over the world attend Doane in Crete, Lincoln, and Bellevue. Whether you're an incoming freshman or transfer student, the decision to make Doane your new home for your undergraduate degree is a smart one.

1. Finish your degree with flexibility

Studies show students at liberal arts schools graduate on time at a higher rate than public universities. Let us help make that happen.

2. An education that’s a great value

There are no hidden fees or add-ons to your bill here. We know your education is an investment, that’s why we offer an outstanding education at an affordable cost.

3. A college of opportunity

We offer students a unique, inclusive setting in intimate classrooms of about 11 students and professors. You’ll receive practical knowledge to get an edge over the competition.

4. Doane degrees matter

Accredited since 1913, we’re dedicated to helping you become the best version of yourself. 86% of our Class of 2018 graduates are employed or continuing their education.

5. We support your journey

We give you the tools and encouragement you need to succeed. We also help make decisions—like financial aid, internships, interviews and class schedules—easier for you.

It’s not tuition – it’s an investment.

An education pays dividends. Our financial aid team will walk you through options – like scholarships, grants, loans or work-study programs – that can help support your decision to come to Doane.
